capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.subtitle: Aurora-Locus features exposed by this deployment

overview.title: Kryphocron Overview
overview.subtitle: Substrate identity, validation status, and recent activity.
overview.shape_mismatch: This deployment declares multi-process but runs the standard single-process rotation oracle. Records still encode, but rotation cadence may diverge across processes — install a coordinated oracle via AtRestHooks.
overview.oracle_pending: Available when Aurora-Locus ships oracle-activity instrumentation.

policy.title: Kryphocron policy
policy.subtitle: Deployment-wide operator policy layered on top of the kryphocron substrate.
policy.codec_help: The friction-encoding codec kryphocron uses for private-tier records at rest. Read-only — stronger at-rest guarantees install a custom ContentCodec at the AtRestHooks seam.
policy.access_help: When new accounts may write private-tier records. Delayed access is a host-side guard applied before the kryphocron capability is issued.
policy.access_earned_pending: Earned access (available when criteria evaluation ships)
policy.default_audience_help: The starting mode for the default audience Aurora-Locus auto-creates at account setup. Account holders maintain their own audiences thereafter.
policy.cadence_help: Deployment-wide cadence for organic Laquna slug rotation. Consulted by the standard oracle on every encode; changes take effect without restart. Governs slug rotation only — record rewrites are operator-triggered (Laquna page).
policy.shape_help: Operator declaration of deployment shape. Multi-process deployments require an operator-supplied coordinated rotation oracle; a mismatch surfaces a warning on the Overview (it does not block encoding).
policy.ratelimits_pending: Available when per-tier rate-limit discrimination ships in an Aurora-Locus backend release.
policy.overrides_pending: Available when the per-account override table ships in an Aurora-Locus backend release.
policy.save_body: Save {key} = {value}? This is recorded in the audit chain.

audiences.title: Audience aggregate
audiences.subtitle: Deployment-wide audience statistics. Read-only — account holders manage their own audiences.
audiences.size_hist_help: Member counts for list-mode audiences; other modes contribute zero.
audiences.empty: No audiences exist on this deployment yet. Audiences are created at account setup; this surface populates as accounts are created.

laquna.title: Laquna
laquna.subtitle: Deployment-wide Laquna rotation. The one-button surface.
laquna.rotate_explainer: Rotating re-encodes existing kryphocron private-tier records under a new generation. CIDs change; at-URIs stay stable, so external references remain valid. A full rewrite takes time proportional to record volume.
laquna.rotate_not: This is friction-as-filtering against casual harvest — not encryption, and not security against a motivated adversary.
laquna.rotate_confirm_body: This rotates the slug and re-encodes every private-tier record under the new generation. Type ROTATE to confirm. Recorded in the audit chain.
laquna.rotate_in_progress: A rotation is already in progress.
laquna.cancel_pending: Cancellation requested — the job will stop at its next batch boundary.
laquna.cancel_confirm_body: Stop the in-progress rewrite at its next batch boundary? A partial rewrite is safe — records carry their own generation and decode regardless. You can re-trigger later.
laquna.cancel_none: No rotation is in progress to cancel.
laquna.cadence_help: Deployment cadence for organic slug rotation, plus the per-account override range. SuperAdmin-write.
laquna.cadence_save_body: Save the rotation cadence and per-account range? Recorded in the audit chain.
